# Overrides for security-scan-tools.txt (passed via `uv pip compile --override`).
#
# semgrep (latest 1.178.0) still pins pyjwt~=2.13.0, which carries a stack of
# PyJWT advisories fixed in 2.14.0/2.15.0. semgrep only imports jwt in its MCP
# token verifier, which the CI scan never runs. Because this forces a version
# outside semgrep's declared range, security-scan.yml installs the compiled
# file with --no-deps (every transitive dep is already hash-pinned in it).
# Drop this once semgrep relaxes its pin.
pyjwt[crypto]>=2.15.1

# semgrep (latest 1.181.0) pins mcp==1.29.0, which is affected by
# GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (unbounded Streamable HTTP sessions), fixed in 1.30.0.
# semgrep only imports mcp for `semgrep mcp`, which the CI scan never runs.
# Capped below 2 so the override stays on the 1.x API semgrep was built for.
# Drop this once semgrep moves its pin to 1.30.0 or later.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2
